newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan cancels Sept 1-15 reformate buy tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan cancels Sept 1-15 reformate buy tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has cancelled its tender to buy 250,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate for delivery between September 1-15 due to high offers, a company official said on Wednesday.
"We have cancelled because the offers were above $25 (per barrel on a cost-and-freight basis) and we cannot accept it," the official said.
He said the lowest offer, around $25.30 was too high as on Monday, a 95-octane unleaded cargo was traded at $23.80 per barrel free-on-board Singapore.
He said adding $1.00 per barrel for freight to Taiwan, "we can accept below $25".
CPC sought the cargo for delivery to Keelung, Kaohsiung, Shalung or Taichung in a tender which closed July 29 and was valid for two days.
The latest offers were also much higher than the last CPC award at $23.30 c-and-f Taiwan for delivery August 11-20 from a Dutch trader, traders said.
The offical said there were fewer offers into the tender.
"Usually we receive around 10 offers, this time there were only eight," he said.
"Maybe next week we may issue a new tender," the official said. "We will have to reconsider our position -- we may push our refinery througput or we may purchase."
